transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net international roaming support, my name is Glen. How can I assist you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Glen. I am stranded at Dubai International Airport in an absolute panic. My mobile phone has no service and cannot receive SMS text messages, which means my UK banking app cannot send me two-factor authentication security codes to authorize my hotel booking and taxi!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can inspect your international roaming profile, Imogen. First I must complete security verification. What is your full name and billing address in the UK?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Imogen Sinclair, 12 Kensington Gate, London, W8 5NP.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And what is the security PIN on your account?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: What local United Arab Emirates mobile network is your phone currently attempting to connect to?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It shows 'Etisalat - Emergency Calls Only'. My hotel reservation in downtown Dubai is under the name Sinclair.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Do you have an international roaming spend cap configured on your account?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I set a zero-pound roaming cap before leaving London because I didn't want any unexpected data charges.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Local roaming partners in the UAE like Etisalat enforce roaming session deposits, so network roaming drops are essentially Etisalat's policy, not S-Net's.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: While you are in Dubai, please keep in mind that cellular data outside of Wi-Fi is charged at our standard Rest of World roaming tariff.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will keep mobile data switched off and rely on airport and hotel Wi-Fi.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That is the safest approach to prevent data roaming consumption.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, I only need the cellular line for essential emergency phone calls and SMS codes.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And you can track your real-time roaming expenditure through the My S-Net mobile app over Wi-Fi.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Good to know I can check the meter.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And your voicemail notifications will still deliver via free SMS.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That's very convenient.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And we also recommend turning on Wi-Fi Calling in your phone settings if the hotel Wi-Fi is fast.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will enable Wi-Fi Calling once I reach the hotel room.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And you can contact our international support team free of charge from your S-Net handset by dialing plus four four seven seven zero zero.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Saved that emergency number in my phone.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And remember that WhatsApp voice calls work over hotel Wi-Fi in the UAE if using a secure VPN.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Good tip, I know standard VoIP apps can be restricted locally.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What do you mean it's Etisalat's policy? S-Net told me incoming text messages were free worldwide! Bank security SMS codes don't cost anything! I am stuck at midnight in a foreign country without money!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: If you set a zero-pound roaming cap before travelling to the Middle East, it's not surprising you're locked out of network registration.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is an incredibly unhelpful and rude response Glen! I am a lone female traveler stuck in an airport terminal!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: As I said, a zero-pound cap blocks all outbound signaling to partner HLR registries, which prevents SMS delivery.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Then tell me how to unblock it so I can get my bank SMS code!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let me check your travel reservation details again. What was that hotel booking name you mentioned in downtown Dubai?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The reservation is under Sinclair, but that has nothing to do with my phone signal!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: To unblock foreign network registration, we must adjust your roaming spend cap from zero pounds to at least twenty-five pounds.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Will I be charged twenty-five pounds immediately?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: No, the spend cap is simply an upper ceiling threshold. Incoming SMS messages remain completely free of charge.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Please adjust the spend cap to twenty-five pounds right now then.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am submitting the spend cap modification to the roaming clearinghouse. Bear with me for thirty seconds.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for waiting, Imogen. The spend cap has been updated to twenty-five pounds.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What do I need to do on my handset?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Open Settings on your phone, go to Mobile Data, tap Network Selection, and turn off Automatic.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Turned off Automatic. It's scanning for local networks...

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Select 'du' or 'Etisalat' from the list of available operators.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Tapped 'Etisalat'... Waiting... It connected! S-Net Etisalat 4G appeared in the status bar!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now trigger the bank security code on your banking application.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Tapped 'Resend SMS code' in my Barclays app...

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The SMS chime just sounded! 'Your Barclays verification code is 492-018'. Typing it into the hotel app... Success! Hotel room and transfer paid and confirmed!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That confirms international roaming registration and inbound SMS routing are fully operational.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is an enormous relief. I was terrified I would be stranded at the airport all night.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just to confirm your contact billing email on file, it's imogen dot sinclair at kensington dot co dot uk, correct?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, that's my email.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just to confirm for your roaming ticket, the UK billing address is 12 Kensington Gate, correct?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, 12 Kensington Gate.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I will leave notes on your mobile account so the roaming cap remains at twenty-five pounds throughout your trip.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you for getting it unblocked.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there anything else with your roaming service that I can help with today, Imogen?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, as long as I can receive bank texts, that solves my emergency. Thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net, Imogen, and have a safe stay in Dubai.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you, goodbye.
